name: Survey tile in Pisces
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.8 degrees south of the ecliptic in Pisces, imaged by SPHEREx 14 times in 6 visits over 57 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 30 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.4 days starting 2026-01-15, at wavelengths from 0.87 to 4.49 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
